title: Deep Core Prospecting from the Grand Exchange (Haven): 5,000 cr, 10 exotic matter, deep core mining XP; 20 platinum ore mined at Bunda Belt (3 jumps)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-22 23:20 UTC (orders ENT-068, P6; rules F34, F37). Foreman Voss offers Deep Core Prospecting on the board of Grand Exchange Station and on six more Nebula boards (table missions, 23:09 UTC); once per pilot (our older copies). Bunda Belt (Nebula space, 3 jumps by Market Prime and Gold Run) reads 1,946 platinum of 8,000, richness 12, beside carbon 1,589 and tungsten 1,067 (census 5.9 h old); min_left 300 keeps the floor our gather there keeps. For the Nebula-born miners' rows only. A test of three results (F37): max_ships 3, the three pilots share the field but draw 60 of 1,646 above the floor. The first stop stores the starter cargo.
